description: displays a movable floating paper note that folds into a pushpin.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Drag the note by its header to move it over the page. The pin folds and opens it.

Keep examples simple and meaningful.

  • Show a useful result.
  • Try the keyboard controls.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Shared tp-color palette name without the tp- prefix; invalid values fall back to yellow.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Optional plain-text heading above the preserved content.

attributes.name: lite
attributes.description: Folds the note into its pushpin; click the pin to expand or fold it again.

attributes.name: opacity
attributes.description: Opacity of the whole note, including its pin, clamped from 0 to 1; invalid or empty values use 1.

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.description: Paper rotation in degrees, clamped from -12 to 12; invalid values use 0.

methods.name: attachTo(element: Element, x: number, y: number, initial = false): void
methods.description: Restores a pin attachment using pixel offsets from the target's top-left corner.

methods.name: moveTo(x: number, y: number): void
methods.description: Places the note in viewport pixels and attaches its pin to the underlying element.

methods.name: resetPosition(): void
methods.description: Restores the loading position in the document without changing content or folded state.

methods.name: toggle(): void
methods.description: Toggles the reflected lite attribute; the pin remains available in both states.

events.name: tp-post-it-move
events.description: Emitted after a pointer or keyboard move, or a position reset; attachment exposes the target and offsets.

events.name: tp-post-it-toggle
events.description: Emitted after the pin changes the folded state.

cssproperties.name: --tp-post-it-width
cssproperties.description: = 20rem Preferred note width, limited by the available space.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-color
dependencies.summary: Brand color preset controller scoped to the containing element.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-post-it>` element displays a movable floating paper note that folds into a pushpin.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Read the note and use any links or components inside it normally. |
| Pushpin | Click to fold or open the note. In lite mode, drag the pin directly to move it without opening it; small movements under 4 pixels remain clicks. Its content is retained. |
| Reset position | Return to the initial position captured when the file loaded, relative to the underlying document. Content and folded state are unchanged. |
| Header | Drag anywhere on the header except its buttons, using a mouse, pen or touch. Pin and Reset keep their normal actions. In lite mode, drag the pin instead. |
| Note surface | Read, select text or use controls without moving the note accidentally. The note does not block interaction with the rest of the page. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the pin, reset, header and interactive content in the expanded note. In lite mode, only the pin remains in keyboard navigation. |
| Enter / Space | Activate the focused reset or pin button. Reset restores the initial document position; the pin folds or expands the note. |
| Arrow keys on the header, or on the pin in lite mode | Move the note by 10 pixels. Hold Shift for 1-pixel steps. |
| Escape during a drag | Cancel the movement and restore the starting position. |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
